name: 検索・複製・移動・保管・書出しを含むページ管理メニュー
prompt: Create ONE production-quality Japanese Lighthouse raster UI component LH09-0113: the tall page-management menu visible in the original crop. Use the attached enlarged original as the authority for geometry, icons, row order, separators, state and scope; Japanese mock is secondary and has missing rows/wrong icons that MUST be restored. White canvas, white tall rounded subtle-border menu, compact readable composition. At approx 323px logical width and 957px logical height scaled up cleanly, preserve source proportions. Body Meiryo Regular 14px/24px, muted hints 12px/16px, zero tracking, avoid heavy text. Search input at top: 操作を検索… with source magnifier. Font selector has large Ag preview above 標準, then 明朝, 等幅; selected Ag uses forest green. Source ordered actions with exact thin outline glyphs: chain リンクをコピー (⌘⌥L); clipboard ページの内容をコピー; two overlapping pages 複製 (⌘D); bent arrow 移動 (⌘⇧P); archive box 保管 and small Beta chip; trash can ごみ箱へ移動. Divider. Screen with play 発表, Beta chip, ⌘⌥P. Divider. A↓ 文字を小さくする ON; ↔ ページ幅を広げる ON; two sliders ページを調整. Divider. Open padlock ページをロック OFF. Original AI wand/face AIを利用 with right chevron. Divider. Comment-pencil 編集を提案; A文 翻訳 with right chevron. Divider. Undo bent-left 元に戻す with ⌘Z. Divider. Down arrow to tray 取込み; up arrow 書出し. Divider. Source swap-arrows-page まとめページへ変更. Divider. Clock 更新と利用状況. At very bottom retain only the source's partially clipped, pale disabled-looking 履歴 row and icon; do not invent any unseen lower rows. Both display switches right thumb ON forest gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E; lock switch neutral gray OFF left thumb. Neutral menus/search/typechoices remain white, not mint. Preserve all rows and source separator grouping, no new heading, no invented icons. Source optical weight thin/slate-gray. Do not use mock's emoji approximations. Single isolated complete component, no browser chrome, watermarks or annotations.
reviewNotes: All original management rows/shortcuts/Beta/ON-ON-OFF states restored and Japanese text inspected. Current candidate over-emphasizes Standard text and expands clipped history row; regular type weight/source crop need a bounded correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
